items.example: You travel through seven different countries.
On a bike you do twenty-five kilometres in an hour.
Along the way you see some of the most beautiful places.
You arrive in Istanbul, Turkey, at the end.
The tour starts in Shanghai and ends in Istanbul.
They cycle across the Pamirs, the Roof of the World.
The cyclists take turns cooking dinner.
They shop in local markets for their food.
The best thing was the friendliness of the people.
The most beautiful places in the world.
You arrive in Istanbul a completely changed person.

items.phrase: Would you like to ... ? Why / Why not?
items.translation: Хотел бы ты ... ? Почему / Почему нет?
items.example: Would you like to go on the Silk Route Tour? — Why not?
